feeds.title: Feline Engineering Blog
feeds.description: Stories, case studies, and recommendations about a wide range of cat behavior topics. Learn more about cats and how they work. Jessica Char is experienced with positive reinforcement training protocols. She has completed extensive coursework in behavior modification and learning theory. Most recently she completed the Cat Behavior and Retention course through the Humane Society of the United States. Jessica spent the last 4 years working with cats in a large animal shelter.

feeds.title: Cat Behavior Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Learn what your cat needs to be a happy, well-behaved companion an what you, as their guardian, can do to make their environment more enriching! Cat Behavior Solutions is a non-profit organization saving lives through innovation and ingenuity. This site, and the work of CBS is dedicated to reducing cat shelter surrender by correcting and preventing behavior issues in the home.

feeds.title: Cat Behavior Alliance Blog
feeds.description: The Mews Cat Behavior Blog is written by Cat Behavior Experts Linda Hall and Rita Reimers, The Cat Behavior Alliance. Linda and Rita's goal is to equip cat parents with the knowledge and tools needed to manage unwanted cat behaviors.

feeds.title: Feral Cat Behavior
feeds.description: Feral Cat Behavior is a blog dedicated to cats and kittens, blogging about feral cats and life in general. Find ca stories, behavior issues management tips and more!

feeds.title: Pawsitive Vibes Cat Blog
feeds.description: Laura Cassiday is a certified cat behavior consultant (CCBC) through the International Association of Animal Behavior Consultants, an Animal Behavior College certified cat trainer, and a Fear Free certified animal trainer. Her ultimate goal is to help cat parents understand their cats better and improve their relationship through positive reinforcement training. The blog is a source for everything a cat parent needs to know about cat behavior.

feeds.title: Cat Behaviourist Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog of Anita Kelsey, Cat Behaviourist. Featuring feline advice, interviews and client testimonials. Anita is a certified and vet referred Cat Behaviour Expert after studying feline psychology and cat behaviour with renowned cat specialist and biologist Roger Tabor. Anita is a species specific behaviourist where she has studied cats only and knows their natural behaviours inside out.

feeds.title: What Your Cat Wants
feeds.description: I'm Dr. Mikel Maria Delgado Ph.D., scientist and established cat expert at Feline Minds. I work with cat owners, animal shelters, and pet-focused corporations to answer cat behavior questions and solve problems. Explore all my research on feline behavior, tips and more in my blog.

feeds.title: Naturally Cats Blog
feeds.description: Naturally Cats Blog supports guardians with understanding their cats. This includes advice on behavior, nutrition, care, environment and enrichment for the cat. Holistic help for cats & their guardians. Cat intuitive, healer & behaviorist. Using a mixture of environment enrichment, behavior modification & botanical remedies to reduce problem cat behaviors.

feeds.title: Catster » Cat Behavior
feeds.description: Learn about common cat behavior habits and problems to help you understand exactly how your cat is feeling. Formerly Cat Fancy, Catster collects helpful and hilarious information for cat lovers. A resource for real cat owners who passionately argue the merits of catnip at dinner, have very real opinions on vet costs, and are willing to devote their time and financial resources to please the creatures that really run their households.

feeds.title: Cat Behavior Associates
feeds.description: Best-selling author & cat expert Pam Johnson-Bennett's training advice, litter box & behavior tips and tricks to improve life with your favorite feline. Pam Johnson-Bennett is the best-selling author of 8 books on cat behavior and training. She starred in the Animal Planet UK series Psycho Kitty, and is one of the most popular and sought-after cat behavior experts in the world.

feeds.title: Modern Cat » Behaviour
feeds.description: From fab finds to fun contests, we bring you the best, latest and most interesting of what's happening in the cat world. Let Modern Cat be your guide to a happier, healthier cat! Learn more about cat behavior, tips to manage and train your cat friends and more!

feeds.title: Maueyes Blog
feeds.description: Kristyn (Shreve) Vitale, Ph.D., is a researcher and educator in animal behavior, animal welfare, and human-animal interaction. Her main area of work focuses on companion animal behavior, specifically cat social cognition, cat behavior, and human-cat interaction. In 2014, Kristyn started Maueyes as a resource on cat behavior, cat science, and cat training. Her research and expertise in cat behavior has been internationally featured in media outlets.

feeds.title: The Purrington Post » Cat Behavior
feeds.description: Know more about cat behavior and characteristics with our articles. Award-winning online lifestyle magazine for cat lovers. We cover the latest trends, fun new topics, tips and products for our furry feline friends. Our goal is to educate, inform and entertain our cat-loving readers!

feeds.title: Fluffy Kitty » Behavior
feeds.description: We travel the world with our adopted cat, Yoda, and write about it. The Fluffy Kitty offers expert guides on cat travel, eco-friendly cat care, and more! Browse through our behavior section to know more about your cat's quirks, behavior signals and more!

feeds.title: Patience for Cats Blog
feeds.description: Read about cat behavior and cat training in the blog of Patience for Cats. Learn about dealing with common behavior problems and basic training. Patience is an Associate Certified Cat Behavior Consultant, with a BS in Biology and a MS in Engineering. She fostered 30 such cats, many of whom were introduced to her cats to see if they could be adopted out to multi-cat households. This gave her multiple experiences with different cats' reactions to being introduced to resident cats.

feeds.title: The Dedicated Feline Enthusiast Blog
feeds.description: As The Dedicated Feline Enthusiast, I blog about all things cats. My ever-growing blog ranging from topics about food to supplements to behavior issues. And being the caregiver of 18 cats and active in the TNR Community, I have a lot of personal experience.

feeds.title: AVSAB » Cat Behavior
feeds.description: Founded in 1976, the American Veterinary Society of Animal Behavior (AVSAB) unites veterinarians and research professionals who share an interest in both understanding animal behavior and treating behavior problems that affect the welfare of animals and the people who care for them. Find our experts' insights into cat behavioral patterns, issues, managing the unexpected tantrums and more!
